name: DG Switchover 验证 — 切换完成后的验证流程
description: Data Guard Switchover 完成后的系统验证规则。验证新主库可读写、新备库同步正常、应用连接切换成功、DG 保护模式恢复。遗漏验证步骤可能导致切换后数据丢失风险或应用故障。

root_causes.name: 新主库未正确 OPEN READ WRITE
root_causes.desc: switchover 后新主库仍处于 MOUNTED 或 READ ONLY 状态，需要手动 ALTER DATABASE OPEN。

root_causes.name: 新备库 MRP 未启动
root_causes.desc: 新备库 MRP 未自动启动，redo apply 中断。apply lag 持续增长。

root_causes.name: redo transport 方向未反转
root_causes.desc: LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n VALID_FOR 配置不当，redo 无法从新主库传输到新备库。

root_causes.name: 应用连接未切换到新主库
root_causes.desc: 应用连接串未配置 failover，DNS/VIP 未切换。

root_causes.name: temp 文件或 SRL 需要调整
root_causes.desc: 新主库 temp 文件可能缺失，新备库可能需要添加 SRL。

step1_verify_roles.sql: SELECT db_unique_name, database_role, open_mode, switchover_status, protection_mode FROM v$database

step2_verify_primary_rw.sql: SELECT open_mode, log_mode, force_logging, flashback_on FROM v$database WHERE database_role = 'PRIMARY'

step3_verify_mrp.desc: 验证新备库 MRP 运行中
step3_verify_mrp.sql: SELECT process, status, thread#, sequence# FROM v$managed_standby WHERE process LIKE 'MRP%' OR process LIKE 'PR%'

step4_verify_transport.desc: 验证 redo transport 正常
step4_verify_transport.sql: SELECT dest_id, status, error, type, transmit_mode, db_unique_name FROM v$archive_dest WHERE target = 'STANDBY' AND status != 'INACTIVE'

step5_verify_lag.desc: 验证 apply lag 正常
step5_verify_lag.sql: SELECT name, value, datum_time FROM v$dataguard_stats WHERE name IN ('apply lag','transport lag')

step6_verify_temp.desc: 验证 temp 文件在线
step6_verify_temp.sql: SELECT file#, status, bytes/1024/1024 size_mb FROM v$tempfile ORDER BY file#

step7_verify_services.sql: SELECT name, network_name FROM v$active_services WHERE name NOT LIKE 'SYS%'

step8_verify_connections.sql: SELECT machine, program, COUNT(*) cnt FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' GROUP BY machine, program ORDER BY cnt DESC
